d: 📢📢📢Looking to hire a qualified Chartered Accountant for Tristar Office in Oman.
r: Complete with accuracy – monthly, quarterly and yearly financial reports within the set deadline.

Conduct review of accounts and validity of balances at the time of monthly closing, ensure adequacy of provisions and ensure that all month closing entries are adequately supported with relevant paperwork.
Oversee company’s operational and revenue generating inventory
Review the reconciliation of Inventory, Supplier and Customer accounts and ensure that adjustment entries, if any are passed with proper approvals.

Ensure timely compilation of information required for the Segment’s MIS reports, including highlighting any variations to the budget and latest forecasts so that corrective action may be initiated by the management. Analyse the financial performance versus prior year.

Ensure compliance with latest accounting standards (IFRS), Group Finance Policy and Procedure Manual. Analyse financial data to detect deficient controls, duplicated effort, fraud, or non-compliance with laws, regulations, and management policies.

Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for the business, financial metrics, such as free cash flow, working capital, net debt, leverage and turnover metrics, ratios, analyze asset utilization and key costs drivers impacting the EBITDA and Net Profit.
Work with the business head to prepare annual budget and forecast projections for the segment.
Ensure that all payments are prepared after checking the authenticity and adequacy of supporting documents and approvals. Ensure adherence to DOA, financial limits as per company policy.
Monitor the Accounts Receivables and overall cash flow in co-ordination with Group Treasury for better fund utilization and working capital management.
Liaise with the Commercial teams to prepare costings and feasibility models to analyze business opportunities.
Ensure that documentation and files necessary for external and internal audits are maintained in a proper manner and provide necessary information for the timely completion of audits.

Where applicable, review the data submitted in compiling tax reports, finalize the returns, in consultation with Company’s Tax Auditors and company’s corporate tax department, handle payment, reporting and/or other tax requirements.
Apart from the duties and responsibilities listed above, any other additional duties as advised by the management from time to time

d: Tivoli Hotels & Resorts is a collection of luxury hotels and resorts set in idyllic beaches and cosmopolitan locations, from iconic destinations in Europe to the Middle East, and from Brazil to Asia. We are timeless, dedicated, and distinctive — evoking a time when hotel stays were grand experiences and travel meant life slowed down for a while.

Founded in 1933, Tivoli’s long-standing heritage is built on extraordinary service, authentic local experiences, and a genuine dedication to the art of hospitality. If you share a passion for making every guest feel they have arrived somewhere truly special, Tivoli is where your story belongs.

This role is critical in establishing the overall Revenue strategy for both Tivoli Bilaj Al Jazayer Bahrain Resort and Avani Bilaj Al Jazayer Bahrain Resort. You will be responsible for maximizing total revenue, optimizing pricing and distribution, and driving market positioning through data-led decision making, while aligning with brand standards and commercial objectives.
q: Bachelor's degree in hotel management or finance.
2 years holding a Revenue Manager position at comparible hotel.
Familiar with the hotel operations, available technology (PMS & RMS) and all distributionchannels.
Understand the dynamics of regional & local markets, as well as local competitors and events.
Key Competencies Required; Coaching & Developing Others, Facilitating Change, Aligning Strategies into Results, Innovation, Problem Analysis and Decision Making.
Not the right fit? Set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!
r: Lead the pre-opening setup of the Revenue Management function, including systems, strategies, processes, and reporting for both properties.
Develop and execute comprehensive revenue strategies across rooms, F&B, and ancillary outlets to maximize profitability and market share.
Establish pricing, yield, and inventory strategies based on market demand, competitive analysis, and forecasting.
Manage and optimize distribution channels, rate parity, and OTA performance in line with brand guidelines.
Conduct regular market, competitor, and demand analysis to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
Prepare and present accurate forecasts, budgets, and revenue reports to senior management.
Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations teams to ensure alignment on commercial strategies.
Oversee the implementation and optimization of revenue management systems and tools.
Monitor and analyze KPIs including RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, market share, and total revenue performance.
Support the Hotel Manager and ownership with strategic insights, scenario planning, and performance recommendations during pre-opening and post-launch phases.
This role is ideal for a forward-thinking revenue leader with strong pre-opening experience and the ability to balance luxury and lifestyle brand strategies within a dynamic resort environment.

d: Mandarin Oriental, Doha is looking for a Guest Relations Agent to join our Front Office team.

Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.

Mandarin Oriental is the award-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting-edge of luxury experiences.

Mandarin Oriental, Doha is an intimate and stylish urban retreat, blending Qatari-influenced heritage with modern design. Located in the heart of Msheireb Downtown Doha, within walking distance to Souq Waqif, Museum of Islamic Art and a short distance to the business district, West Bay.
r: Based at Mandarin Oriental, Doha within the Front Office Department in Doha, The Guest Relations Agent will meet and exceed guest expectations by providing efficient and courteous Guest Relations service in accordance with Legendary Quality Experiences. The Guest Relations Agent will meet, greet and escort all VIP guests and will ensure a smooth arrival and a fond farewell. It is the mission and intent of this position that the incumbent will keep the guest’s perspective in mind at all times and carry out the mission of the Rooms Division. The Guest Relations Agent reports to the Concierge and Guest Relations Manager.
As Guest Relations Agent, you will be responsible for the following duties
Help the Guest Relations Supervisor to inspect all VIPs rooms prior to arrival and ensure all requests are met
Help the Guest Relations Management Team to meet and greet guests
Handle amenity requests and other guest relations programmes
Run and Participate in the VIPs meeting
Assists the Front Office during need periods
Works closely with Front Office, Housekeeping, Room Services, Concierge and all F&B departments
As Guest Relations Agent, we expect from you
Minimum 2 year of experience working in a 5-star hotel environment
A minimum of 1 years of Front Office experience
Previous experience working in the Middle East Region is an advantage
Strong commands of Microsoft Office products
Effective verbal and written communication skills in English. Arabic is an advantage
Learning & Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously.

MOstay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the #MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones.

Heath & Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally.
Retirement Plans. When you show commitment to us, we reciprocate. We offer different retirement plans depending on the length of your service and your role.
A competitive salary and benefits packages

q: We are looking for a high-performing Senior Sales Account Manager to manage and develop strategic accounts, drive new business opportunities, and achieve sales growth across various sectors in the Saudi market.

Sales Experience: A minimum of 10 years of proven ICT sales experience, with experience in at least one of the following Saudi market sectors: Defense & Security, Central Government, Semi-Government, Banking & Finance, Telecom, or Commercial.

ICT Solutions & Services: Strong knowledge and proven experience in selling ICT solutions and services, including IT Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Cloud Computing, Digital Transformation, and Managed Services.
Industry Background: Previous experience working with System Integrators or Turnkey Solutions Providers is mandatory.
Education: A bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field is required.

Business Development & Sales Performance: Proven ability to identify and develop new business opportunities, build and manage a strong sales pipeline, and consistently achieve revenue and profitability targets, with a demonstrated track record of sales achievements over the past three years.

Strategic Account Management: Strong experience in account planning, complex solution selling, and managing end-to-end sales cycles, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with senior executives and key decision-makers.
Tendering & Bidding: Experience managing complex RFPs, RFQs, and tenders, including close coordination with presales, technical, and commercial teams.
Commercial & Negotiation Skills: Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to manage pricing strategies, contract negotiations, and deal profitability.
Market Relationships: Established relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders within the targeted Saudi market sectors are required.
Technology Vendor Experience: Experience working with leading global ICT technology vendors and managing strategic partnerships is an advantage.
Sales Management Tools: Proficiency in CRM systems, sales forecasting, pipeline management, and reporting.
Communication Skills: Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills in both Arabic and English.
Nationality: Saudi nationals are strongly preferred.
Residency: Non-Saudi candidates must hold a transferable Iqama.

d: We are looking for a highly talented Senior Software Engineer to join our Engineering team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. If you are looking for an opportunity to work on scalable systems, solve complex technical challenges, and make a meaningful impact, this may be the place for you!

The ideal candidate will be a strong individual contributor with a proven track record in backend development, software architecture, and building reliable, high-performance systems. As a senior member of the team, you will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and other cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software and drive technical excellence across the organization.
Contributing to architectural decisions and designing scalable, reliable, and secure backend systems that support millions of users.
Actively participating in the evolution of our backend architecture, including migrating monolithic applications into microservices.
Designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality backend services and APIs to support business and technical requirements.
Building and optimizing systems to handle increasing scale, performance, and reliability requirements.
Working with Docker containers, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform.
Applying software engineering best practices, including Design-Driven Development, SOLID principles, Domain-Driven Design, and Event-Driven Architecture.
Collaborating with cross-functional and agile teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
Contributing to continuous improvements in test coverage, code quality, refactoring, and technical documentation.
Demonstrating strong code review, debugging, and investigation skills to ensure the quality and reliability of our systems.
Supporting and mentoring other engineers, sharing technical knowledge, and contributing to the overall growth of the engineering team.
q: 5+ years of experience in backend software development using Go, Ruby on Rails (RoR), Java, or Python.

Strong database expertise with PostgreSQL and NoSQL databases, including a solid understanding of normalization, ACID principles, isolation levels, indexing, query optimization, and caching solutions such as Redis or Memcached.
Experience with monitoring, alerting, and logging tools such as Grafana.
Strong understanding of software architecture, including Domain-Driven Design (DDD), microservices, Kubernetes, and containerization.
Hands-on experience with monolithic application migration and modernizing backend architectures.
Strong testing mindset, with experience writing unit and integration tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software design principles.
Strong adaptability and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, work in a dynamic environment, and make informed technical decisions.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering and cross-functional teams.
